result.summary: The page is mostly polished, but there are a few visible layout problems, especially in the restaurant card metadata where text appears to overlap.

issues.description: The metadata under “Tokumaru Ramen Bar” is visually broken: the delivery time, delivery fee, and category text overlap or collide, making the line hard to read.
issues.suggestion: Increase the available vertical or horizontal spacing for the metadata row, prevent text overlap, and use proper separators or wrapping/truncation rules.

issues.description: Some horizontally scrollable content is clipped at the right edge, including the category chips and the restaurant cards in “Fastest near you.” This may be intentional, but it looks abrupt because partial elements are visible without clear scroll affordance.
issues.suggestion: Add consistent side padding, ensure partial cards are intentionally cropped, or show a clearer horizontal scroll indicator/spacing.

issues.description: The bottom navigation bar cuts across the second restaurant card image, making the card look partially hidden behind the fixed navigation area.
issues.suggestion: Add bottom padding to the scrollable content equal to the height of the bottom navigation bar plus safe-area spacing so cards are not obscured.
